lines.zh: 行尸缓慢挪动，发出声响。
饥饿的咀嚼声，啃咬腐肉。
僵尸缓慢移动，步履蹒跚。
腐烂的肌肉发出嘎吱声。

lines.en: One leg drags across the gravel.

lines.zh: 关节反着弯，还在往前走。
lines.en: A joint bends backwards, and still I walk.

lines.zh: 行尸的喉咙发出咕噜声。
行尸突然抬头看向玩家。
lines.en: Walker suddenly looks at the player.

lines.zh: 行尸盯着玩家，腐烂的双眼闪烁。
lines.en: Walker stares at the player, rotting eyes glowing.

lines.zh: 行尸伸出腐烂的手臂，试图触碰玩家。
lines.en: Walker reaches out with its rotting arm.

lines.zh: 行尸张开嘴，露出腐烂的牙齿。
lines.en: Walker opens its mouth, revealing rotten teeth.

lines.zh: 行尸的眼睛转动，寻找目标。
行尸的头部转动，寻找玩家。
lines.en: Walker's head turns, looking for the player.

lines.zh: 行尸发出嘶嘶声，似乎注意到玩家。

lines.en: Walker tries to get closer to the player.

lines.zh: 行尸的视线锁定在远处玩家身上。
lines.en: Walker's gaze locks on the player.

lines.zh: 腐肉被打掉了，露出骨头。
lines.en: The rot is knocked off, showing bone.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指伸向你，别靠近！
lines.en: Decaying fingers reach out, stay back!
Your blood smells sweet through the wall.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，也拖得住你。
lines.en: I drag one leg, and I'll drag you too.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我咬定了。
lines.en: Whatever's in your hand, my teeth claim it.

lines.zh: 你袖口的血味，我隔着三步就闻到。
lines.en: I smell the blood on your cuff from three steps away.

lines.zh: 腐肉挂在你肩上，别怪我咬。
lines.en: Rotten flesh on your shoulder; do not blame my bite.

lines.zh: 我拖着断腿，也要挡在你门前。
lines.en: Even with a broken leg, I will block your door.
My leg drags. Get out of the way.

lines.zh: 撞上我，伤口会烂得更快。
lines.en: Bump into me and that wound rots faster.

lines.zh: 你烂得刚好，和我这一身配。
lines.en: You are rotten just right to match this body of mine.

lines.zh: 废墟底下，我们挤进同一间屋。
lines.en: Under the ruins we crowd into the same room.

lines.zh: 你也被咬过，脖子上的印还在。
lines.en: You were bitten too; the mark is still on your neck.

lines.zh: 这里的食物够我吃很久。
lines.en: Food will last a long time.

lines.zh: 我的第 7 张脸认得你。
瓦砾那边有活人翻箱子的声音。
lines.en: Beyond the rubble, a living one rummages in a chest.

lines.zh: 活人的热量，隔老远就闻到。
lines.en: Living heat carries a long way to me.

lines.zh: 你在废墟里翻箱子的声音。
lines.en: I hear you rummaging in the ruins.

lines.zh: 这一带就你一个还在喘气。
lines.en: You are the only one here still breathing.
Your tracks are fresh and still warm.

lines.zh: 别躲了，风把你的味道送来了。
lines.en: No point hiding; the wind brought your scent.
Your scent drifts to me on the wind.

lines.zh: 我数着你喘气的间隔，一下一下。
lines.en: I count the gaps between your breaths.

lines.zh: 我的断腿拖着，方向可没歪。
lines.en: My broken leg drags, but my heading is true.

lines.zh: 我的腿断了，还在往前走。
lines.en: My leg broke. I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我的手已经朝你伸出来了。
lines.en: My hand is already reaching for you.

lines.zh: 你退到断墙后面，我也绕过去。
lines.en: You retreat behind the broken wall; I go around.
No hurry. I walk over slowly.
This bite will leave a mark.
Run, and I stay right behind.

lines.zh: 被咬过的伤口，可治不好。
lines.en: A bitten wound never really heals.

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里还夹着上一个。
lines.en: There is still the last one between my teeth.

lines.zh: 你握着武器的手在发抖。

lines.en: The rot will teach you pain, slowly.

lines.zh: 在你回头之前，我就到了。
lines.en: I arrive before you finish turning.

lines.zh: 我不想杀你，我只想咬你。
lines.en: I do not want to kill you; I want to bite you.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的前臂，不松口。
lines.en: I clamp onto your forearm and do not let go.

lines.zh: 快跑，否则你会变成行尸！
lines.en: Run, or you’ll turn into a Walker!
Bit me, you’ll become like me!

lines.zh: 我在这里等你，尝尝我的嘴吧！
lines.en: I’ll wait here, try my bite!
My hand lifts with nails peeled back.
You don’t want to be like this!

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里还塞着上一个人的布。
lines.en: Cloth from the last one is still stuck in my teeth.
My teeth tear through your sleeve!
The wound is bleeding now, is it not?
Forget your leg; guard your neck!
Once I bite, you will change too!

lines.zh: 腐臭的指甲抠进你皮肤！
lines.en: Rotting nails dig into your skin!
In the dark, I wait for you!

lines.zh: 我从超市的卷帘门下爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from under the supermarket shutter.

lines.zh: 我从不死，我只化为行尸！
lines.en: I never die, I just become a Walker!

lines.zh: 这条街只剩你还在喘气。
lines.en: On this street you are the only one still breathing.

lines.zh: 从废墟的瓦砾堆里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the rubble of the ruins.

lines.zh: 全群系都有我们，今天到你这。
lines.en: We walk every biome; today it is yours.

lines.zh: 末世之后，我慢慢站起来。
lines.en: After the end, I slowly stand up.
The first one to arrive is me.
